declarations.description:
The usual list to choose from: icon, name and a note per line. One line is selected at a time (click it again to clear), and with Ctrl, Cmd or Shift + click
lines are marked, any number, for the application to do something with them (join them). It knows nothing about what the items are.

```html
<wax-item-list empty="Nothing here"></wax-item-list>
```
```js
list.items = sites.map(s => ({ key: s.id, icon: '🍺', name: s.name, note: `${s.meters} m`, faded: s.hidden }));
list.addEventListener('wax-select', event => open(event.detail.key));   // key is null when the selection is cleared
list.addEventListener('wax-mark', event => join(event.detail.keys));
```

Two things a list can also do, if asked:
- **Move** (`movable`): each line has a handle, dragged with mouse or finger, or moved with the arrow keys when it has the focus; the list gives back the keys in their
  new order (`wax-move`).
- **Swipe** (`swipe-label`): sliding a line sideways with the finger uncovers one action (Remove, Seen) instead of doing it straight away (`wax-swipe`).
declarations.name: WaxItemList

cssProperties.description: The mark of the selected and marked lines (`--wa-color-brand-fill-loud`)
cssProperties.name: --item-accent

cssParts.description: One line. Also `selected`, `marked`, `faded` and `dragging` while they are so
cssParts.name: line

cssParts.description: The text of an empty list
cssParts.name: empty

cssParts.description: The action a slid line uncovers
cssParts.name: swipe

slots.description: Own controls at the end of a line: a child with `slot="<key of the item>"`. (An item's `html` is put there for you.) One with class `item-risky` shows only when the line is under the mouse or has the focus

members.name: OWN
members.default: 'a, button, input, label, select, textarea, wa-button, wa-input, wa-select, [part~="handle"]'
members.description: Clicks on these inside a line belong to them, not to the list

members.name: items
members.description: The lines. What was selected or marked stays so if its key is still there

members.name: marked
members.description: The keys marked with Ctrl, Cmd or Shift + click (read only; `clearMarks()` empties it)

members.name: select
members.description: Selects an item without telling anybody (the map chose it): `scroll` brings it into view.

members.name: clearMarks
members.description: Clears the marks, without telling anybody

members.name: selected
members.description: The key of the selected line; `select(key, { scroll })` sets it without firing `wax-select`

members.name: empty
members.description: What it says with no items

members.name: movable
members.description: Lines have a handle to reorder them

members.name: swipeLabel
members.description: The text of the action that a slid line uncovers (attribute `swipe-label`)

events.description: A line was clicked (or Enter or Space on it). `detail: { key }`, `key` null when the selection was cleared. Not fired by `select()`
events.name: wax-select

events.description: A line was marked or unmarked with Ctrl, Cmd or Shift + click. `detail: { keys }`, all the marked ones
events.name: wax-mark

events.description: A line was moved (`movable`). `detail: { keys }`, all of them in their new order
events.name: wax-move

events.description: The action of a slid line was pressed (`swipe-label`). `detail: { key }`
events.name: wax-swipe

attributes.description: The key of the selected line; `select(key, { scroll })` sets it without firing `wax-select`
attributes.name: selected

attributes.description: What it says with no items
attributes.name: empty

attributes.description: Lines have a handle to reorder them
attributes.name: movable
